predicates.name: CLAIMS
predicates.definition: Subject presents the object as a claim or asserted content.
examples: An assertion records that a local entity claims literal content.

predicates.name: DEPICTS
predicates.definition: Subject depicts or represents the object in the source-relative record.
examples: Evidence depicts a referenced local entity.

predicates.name: SUPPORTS
predicates.definition: Subject supports the object without by itself making the object omnisciently true.

predicates.name: CONTRADICTS
predicates.definition: Subject supplies source-relative contradiction or counterevidence to the object.
examples: One evidence record contradicts an assertion.

predicates.name: MAPS_TO
predicates.definition: Subject has an explicit crosswalk or registry mapping to the object; this is not global identity equivalence.
examples: A local registry record maps to an external registry record.

predicates.name: SAME_AS
predicates.definition: Candidate identity relation asserting sameness under a governed identity scope.
examples: A local entity is proposed as same as another identity target.

predicates.name: COUNTERPART_OF
predicates.definition: Candidate identity relation for counterpart entities without asserting sameness.
examples: A local entity is proposed as a counterpart of another.

predicates.name: CAUSES
predicates.definition: Candidate causal relation from subject to object.
examples: An event-like assertion is proposed to cause another.

predicates.name: LOCATED_AT
predicates.definition: Candidate spatial relation locating the subject at the object.
examples: A local entity is proposed as located at a referenced place entity.

predicates.name: MEMBER_OF
predicates.definition: Candidate membership relation from subject to organization or group object.
examples: A local entity is proposed as a member of another local entity representing a group.

predicates.name: REMEMBERS
predicates.definition: Candidate relation recording remembered content without promoting the remembered event to objective truth.
examples: A local entity is proposed as remembering a source-relative evidence item.

predicates.name: STATE_CHANGED
predicates.definition: Candidate relation recording a state transition supported by source-relative evidence.
examples: A local entity is proposed as undergoing a described state change.

predicates.name: IDENTITY_DIVERGES
predicates.definition: Candidate identity relation recording divergence from an identity target without resolving all continuity dimensions.
examples: A local entity is proposed as diverging from another identity target.

predicates.name: TIMELINE_BRANCHES
predicates.definition: Candidate relation recording a timeline branch without asserting global continuity resolution.
examples: An assertion is proposed to describe a branch from another timeline-scoped assertion.
